title: Smps FFA Recreation
description: This is a network of FFA servers full of smp plugin  that we recreated   such as infuse Strength and unstable
body:
This is SFR otherwise known as SMP FFA Recreation/ SMP Recreated FFA 

In SFR we create FFA servers with plugins from numerous popular SMPs

These SMPS Consist of Infuse SMP, Strength SMP And Unstable SMP  (Altar coming soon!)

We  plan to extend out network to more then just SMP plugins.

This means that we  plan to create servers such as mace prac or even a server with our   OWN custom  plugin
